plan.title: Measure controlled synthetic warm and input-cold status performance

criteria.description: In the approved isolated Linux guest collect exactly 30 valid guarded samples per mode for 10000 files, 100 MiB and three passing checks. Fix source, binary, collector and workload; retain raw results and any rejected attempts. Verify per-sample manifest binding and cold transitions within the existing 100 ms bound.
Independently recompute median, nearest-rank p95 and maximum waited-child RSS from the fixed sample sets, publish anonymized results and decide whether warm p95 is at most two seconds.

limitations: Synthetic workload only. Actual guest measurement is required before closure; the automated tests verify protocol behavior. Guest input page evidence does not establish host/storage cache state.
